name: Murloc Thieves
summary: Saria Fairmoon seeks the Memory Crystal taken by Razorgill near the Tower of Eldara. Its strange voices may hold arcane power.

sections.title: A Crystal Recovered
sections.body: The Memory Crystal reaches Saria Fairmoon in Azshara intact. Its clamoring voices stir her curiosity, and she finds them alluring. The crystal may hold the key to arcane power, and it is a piece of history saved.

faq.answer: Saria Fairmoon in Azshara asks you to bring her the Memory Crystal.
Razorgill has the Memory Crystal near the Tower of Eldara.
Saria calls the Memory Crystal a piece of history. Its voices may hold the key to arcane power.

faq.q: What is strange about the crystal?
faq.answer: The Memory Crystal has clamoring voices that Saria finds curious and alluring.
